latest_release.body: ## Announcement Read the official announcement: [Announcing GoReleaser v2.20](https://goreleaser.com/blog/goreleaser-v2.20/). ## Changelog ### Security updates * 0b1b1fff41ab7113cdb6858ac45a1cf7f9bebc92: sec(git): redact URL credentials from diagnostics (#7294) (@caarlos0) ([GHSA-7qv4-9g3j-wvq8](https://github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser/security/advisories/GHSA-7qv4-9g3j-wvq8)) * 9a037e1fd427402b52c117f0de38614972b909bb: sec(srpm): reject RPM macros in package versions (#7295) (@caarlos0) ([GHSA-rjp9-h7gp-wr7q](https://github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser/security/advisories/GHSA-rjp9-h7gp-wr7q)) * fb9617b200efc33bb7fa63b5a2c005949fc5d566: sec: redact hook and chocolatey secrets from logs (#7293) (@caarlos0) ([GHSA-gvxm-cvj4-qwvp](https://github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser/security/advisories/GHSA-gvxm-cvj4-qwvp)) ### Bug fixes * 0946e5ed0111de64e577d16f6802e755c956e366: fix(aur): install every binary of the archive in the default package (#7284) (@lbarrosby) * 79c8d685b968bb083c73c2ed72ac8ede54d2192d: fix(client): defer SSH private-key expansion until publishing (#7273) (@caarlos0) * e46cd64808b1fde7d770b2ec64b80f052560c943: fix(docs): remove duplicate prebuilt redirects (@caarlos0) * 5f422b18d5245cbece678da34eefdb542e0a08f6: fix(ko): accept '..' as main path (#7279) (@mrueg) * a8f1c1ec8f3991588f8c41abf22eb5c80aeb740c: fix(ko): prefer remote base images and don't cache failed lookups (#7275) (@mrueg) * 3432e8d530ceeabf38edf26b5399006baad9f4e2: fix(mcp): retry publish when package version is not yet visible (#7283) (@santhiprakash) * 119f88f695dc34e4b6f04c34e22005955d5675f8: refactor(ko): simplify template handling (#7277) (@mrueg) ### Documentation updates * 3286c23e755afa57959c32dda751a8b169736d97: docs: .ArtifactPath is not always an absolute path (#7289) (@ZainnQureshii) ### Other work * ed8efe6a52def7b44443e0779021c3439b24ca5b: chore: auto-update generated files (#7274) (@goreleaserbot) **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser/compare/v2.20.0...v2.20.1 ## Helping out This release is only possible thanks to **all** the support of some **awesome people**! Want to be one of them? You can [sponsor](https://goreleaser.com/sponsors/), get a [Pro License](https://goreleaser.com/pro) or [contribute with code](https://goreleaser.com/contributing). ## Where to go next? * Find examples and commented usage of all options in our [website](https://goreleaser.com/intro/). * Reach out on [Discord](https://discord.gg/RGEBtg8vQ6), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/goreleaser), and [Telegram](https://t.me/goreleasernews)!

detail.readme:
GoReleaser

Release engineering, simplified.

--- We handle the complexities of releasing so you can focus in building what really matters: **your software**. ![](https://goreleaser.com/static/goreleaser.svg) --- ## Get GoReleaser - [On your machine](https://goreleaser.com/install/); - [On CI/CD systems](https://goreleaser.com/ci/). ## Documentation Documentation is hosted live at https://goreleaser.com ## Community You have questions, need support and or just want to talk about GoReleaser? Here are ways to get in touch with the GoReleaser community: [![Follow on 𝕏](https://img.shields.io/badge/Follow_on_𝕏-000000?style=for-the-badge&logo=x&logoColor=white)](https://twitter.com/goreleaser) [![Follow Telegram Channel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Follow_on_Telegram-26A5E4?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=%23FFFFFF)](https://t.me/goreleasernews) [![GitHub Discussions](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discuss_on_GITHUB-181717?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/goreleaser/goreleaser/discussions) You can find the links above and all others [here](https://goreleaser.com/links/). ### Code of Conduct This project adheres to the Contributor Covenant [code of conduct](https://github.com/goreleaser/.github/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). By participating, you are expected to uphold this code. We appreciate your contribution.
